theorems.name: Submission.bv_ext_exists_cutoffs
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (ξ : Rn n) (r : ℝ), IsOpen U → Bornology.IsBounded U → Convex ℝ U → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ U → ∃ φ : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ, (∀ j, ∃ K, LipschitzWith K (φ j)) ∧ (∀ j x, 0 ≤ φ j x ∧ φ j x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ j, HasCompactSupport (φ j)) ∧ (∀ j, tsupport (φ j) ⊆ U) ∧ (∀ x, Tendsto (fun j ↦ φ j x) atTop (𝓝 (U.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x))) ∧ ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, r * ‖fderiv ℝ (φ j) x‖ ≤ -fderiv ℝ (φ j) x (x - ξ)
